root_cause.code: gid = str(g.game_id) if pd.notna(g.game_id) else None; if gid is None or g.tip <= now: continue
root_cause.statement: The gate requires an official game_id before an obligation exists for it. game_id is supplied only by data/ref_assignments/assignments_log.csv (coverage_audit.py:116-124) or by a COMPLETED game in master_team.parquet (coverage_audit.py:128-142); neither can apply to an unplayed game before referee assignments are published. Referee assignments arrive on the morning of the game, roughly 12 hours AFTER that game's T-24h cutoff, so no T-24h obligation is ever discoverable in time. The gate's identity rule is strictly stricter than that of the job it guards: daily_forecast.py:561-563 already mints PROV-<slate_date>-<away>@<home> and sets game_id_provisional when the id is absent, and coverage_audit.py:148-168 resolves those ids retroactively.
root_cause.silence_mechanism: Dropped rows never reach `upcoming`, so nothing is printed for them, and the decline falls through to the `elif not in_window` branch (should_run_base.py:97-98), which attributes the decline to the lead window. The lead window did not cause it.
